(2) Recipe evidence is the krita-deps-management branch transition.now/qt6.8.0 at its tip b3f405c1 (2026-09-29, one day before tag v6.0.4.1, unchanged since); CI consumes prebuilt dep packages from KDE's artifact cache built from that branch, so a cache build from an older commit cannot be fully excluded - but every version-bearing DLL checked (Qt 6.8.0, ANGLE f2280c0c5f93, ICU 72.1, FreeType 2.12.1, zlib 1.3.1, xz 5.2.6, FFmpeg libavcodec 61.19.101/7.1.1, x265 4.1+190, libvpl 2.14, SDL 2.26, LAME 3.100, theora 1.2.0, OpenSSL 1.1.1l, Python 3.13.5, PyQt6 6.8.1, poppler 26.02.0, png 1.6.51, tiff 4.4.0, exiv2 0.27.5, heif 1.21.2, openjpeg 2.5.4, LibRaw 0.20.2, expat 2.4.8, harfbuzz 5.3.1, fribidi 1.0.11, mlt 7.28.0, de265 1.0.16, vpx 1.13.1, opus 1.5.2, FLAC 1.4.2, vorbis 1.3.7, OCIO 2.5.1, jpeg-turbo 2.1.4, json-c 0.18, aom 3.13.1) matches the recipe. FFTW reports 3.3.9 while recipe pins 3.3.10 (believed to be the known fftw-3.3.10 CMake version string quirk) - treat FFTW as probable. (3) Toolchain runtime (libc++, libunwind, libomp, libwinpthread) version comes from the CI VM image script (llvm-mingw 20251118 -> LLVM 21.1.6, mingw-w64 f6a7b25b), not from a binary version resource -> probable. (4) OpenSSL 1.1.1l DLLs are a prebuilt files.kde.org openssl-1.1.1l_4-win64-mingw.zip (looks like an MSYS2 package build, release _4); the MSYS2 PKGBUILD/patches for that build are no longer on repo.msys2.org, so only the pristine upstream 1.1.1l tarball is listed. Python embed zip and PyQt-builder bundled OpenSSL 1.1.1b/MSVC DLLs are third-party binaries redistributed unchanged; their sources are listed from the upstream projects (cpython-source-deps tags per get_externals.bat). (5) Header-only/static libs (Eigen, immer, zug, lager, xsimd, Highway, GSL, unibreak, libaom, ANGLE zlib) are listed because they are compiled into shipped binaries. KCrash and other ext_* in the repo are not shipped on Windows and are omitted; build-only tools (nasm, perl, patch, gperf, meson wraps other than listed) are omitted. (6) Sizes of dynamic Git archives (github codeload / GitLab -/archive/) are what the server reported or streamed at check time (HEAD, range Content-Range, or full stream count <=20 MB with gzip/zip integrity test); such archives are regenerated on demand and their byte size/hash is not guaranteed stable - mirror them once and record sha256.
